Charles Sturt University is Australia’s largest regional university with more than 380 undergraduate and postgraduate courses, Charles Sturt can help you start, progress or change your career. And you can choose to study on campus, online or by mixed-mode, however suits you best. 
 
We have more than 42,000 students from across Australia and more than 100 countries across the globe
 
With world-class facilities for hands-on learning, extensive industry accreditation, and Australia’s highest graduate employment rate, Charles Sturt is here to help you reach your career goals.

🔗 Links:

Home Page: https://www.csu.edu.au

How to Apply: https://study.csu.edu.au/apply

Support: https://study.csu.edu.au/apply/scholarships-grants

Accommodation: https://www.csu.edu.au/current-students/uni-life/accommodation

📞 Got questions? visit  https://study.csu.edu.au/contact-us or call us directly at 1800 275 278.
